warning: Indian statutes mandate retention minimums, not confidentiality lifetimes. Retention entries are planning inputs, not proof that confidentiality is legally required for the same duration.

sources.title: Companies Act, 2013, section 128(5)
sources.citation: Books of account are retained for eight financial years.

sources.title: Income-tax Act, 1961, section 149
sources.citation: Assessment and record-retention horizon used as a six-year minimum.

sources.title: RBI Master Direction - Know Your Customer
sources.citation: Regulated entities retain identification records for at least five years.

sources.title: Aadhaar (Targeted Delivery of Financial and Other Subsidies, Benefits and Services) Act, 2016
sources.citation: Aadhaar information is sensitive identity data; this profile does not infer a statutory confidentiality lifetime.

sources.title: Trinetra retention planning assumptions 2026.1
sources.citation: Reviewed planning assumptions, not Indian statutory confidentiality requirements.

aadhaar_pii.caveat: Planning assumption; the cited Act does not supply an eight-year confidentiality lifetime.

health_record.caveat: Planning assumption pending an organisation-specific retention and confidentiality policy.

tax_record.caveat: Tax retention is a statutory minimum, not a measured confidentiality lifetime.

payment_card_data.caveat: Planning assumption; use the merchant's card-data policy where available.

biometric.caveat: Trinetra planning assumption; no Indian statute is asserted as its basis.

credential_secret.caveat: Trinetra planning assumption; no Indian statute is asserted as its basis.

session_token.caveat: Planning fallback only; an application-specific session lifetime should replace it.

employee_record.caveat: Planning assumption pending HR and contractual retention requirements.

source_code_secret.caveat: Planning assumption; rotate exposed secrets immediately regardless of this horizon.
